justification: Both surfaces show flat, solid-silhouette schematic petroglyph-type imagery dominated by a single long horizontal motif with repeated regular undulations — the boat's row of crew strokes in A and the serpentine wave in B — accompanied by small isolated figures (a quadruped in A, a dot and an arms-raised human in B) in the upper field. The depicted subjects nevertheless differ substantially: A shows a crewed boat with upcurved prow and stem ornaments and an animal, while B shows a snake-like undulating line beside a standing anthropomorph, so the correspondence is one of general convention rather than a shared specific scene.
